name: Protein Pancakes
method: Blend the oats, banana, eggs and milk until you have a thick batter, and leave to stand for 2 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan over a medium heat.
Cook spoonfuls of batter for 2 minutes each side until golden and set, in batches.
Stack the pancakes on a plate, spoon over the peanut butter and serve.
